observations.finding: Content stage uses overflow:auto; vertical-only nested renderer policy is not enforced.
Horizontal feed gesture is attached only to #feedGesture.
Sheet handle supports dragging and split state; viewport-bottom origin is not implemented.
Dashboard button supports downward drag; viewport-top origin is not implemented.
Fixed and favorite app groups exist; settings is supplied by the host. Since 0.3.1 a host may give each entry its own short icon, since 0.3.2 a badge count.
Favorites and reaction rails have translucent background, blur, borders and shadows. Since 0.3.1 a host can hide the resources a content does not accept (open() accepts).
No keydown handler exists in the reviewed shell/controller files.
Dashboard entry exists; dedicated desktop AI invocation and shared glass entry controls are absent.

bounds: Existing source support is not a browser verification of the new edge/axis/shortcut contract. All audited UI artifact digests correspond to sourceRevision.
refreshNote: Re-inspected at 0.3.1 and again at 0.3.2 (open result, badges, focusable chat list): the cited lines moved; every finding and status still holds. No keydown handler or edge-origin gesture was added.
